sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

The core gameplay mechanics of Abandoned Places Picture Tile Quest are straightforward yet engaging. The game consists of a grid of tiles, each representing a small part of a larger picture. Your goal is to slide these tiles around the grid to reassemble the complete image. The twist? You can only move tiles adjacent to each other, either horizontally or vertically. This simple yet clever mechanic requires strategic thinking and planning to solve the puzzles. As you progress through the levels, the difficulty increases, and you'll encounter tiles with different colors, patterns, and shapes, making it even more challenging to solve the puzzles.

The game also features a 'swap' feature, which allows you to swap two tiles at a time. This feature is incredibly useful, especially when you're stuck and need to try a different approach.
